product: AIRS/Aqua L3 monthly standard physical retrieval V7.0 (AIRS3STM)

collection.title: Aqua/AIRS L3 Monthly Standard Physical Retrieval (AIRS-only) 1 degree x 1 degree V7.0

source_variable: TotH2OVap_A and TotH2OVap_D (kg/m2, mean of the two)
access: Earthdata Login (environment token); GES DISC OPeNDAP DAP4 server-side subset of 4 variables per month in one request, in memory (no raw file kept)
regrid: none: AIRS3STM is already 1 degree, row 0 = 89.5N; (TotH2OVap_A + TotH2OVap_D) / 2
note: Raw granules are not kept; only the 1-degree monthly derivative is shipped. No trend statistic is computed in the build.
